California Treatment Centers serves Fresno and the surrounding area with a full continuum of addiction care, connecting residents to clinically appropriate treatment whether they prefer to stay close to home or step away to focus on recovery.

We are a statewide provider with multiple real California locations, and we help Fresno-area clients find the right level of care, verify their benefits, and arrange travel or placement when that makes sense for their situation.

Treatment Options for Fresno Residents

Recovery is not one-size-fits-all. We help match each person to a level of care based on a clinical assessment, medical history, and personal circumstances.

Medical Detox

Supervised medical detox can help manage withdrawal from alcohol, opioids, benzodiazepines and other substances with monitoring and support.

Residential Treatment

Structured, live-in residential treatment offers a stable environment away from daily triggers.

PHP & IOP

Partial hospitalization and intensive outpatient programs provide robust daytime structure while allowing clients to return home or to sober housing.

Outpatient & Aftercare

Flexible outpatient treatment supports work, school and family responsibilities during recovery.

Levels of Care

  • Medical detox and withdrawal management
  • Residential / inpatient treatment
  • Partial hospitalization (PHP)
  • Intensive outpatient (IOP)
  • Standard outpatient and aftercare planning
  • Sober living and structured recovery housing
  • Sober companionship for added one-on-one support

The Central Valley Context

Fresno sits within reach of Clovis, Madera, Visalia and the broader San Joaquin Valley. Local resources can be stretched, and waitlists are common. Because we operate across California, we can often help Fresno-area clients access care more quickly, including options in other regions when local availability is limited or when distance from familiar triggers supports recovery.

What to Expect When You Reach Out

Calling for help can feel overwhelming, especially for Fresno families balancing work, childcare and the seasonal rhythms of valley life. Our admissions team starts with a simple, confidential conversation: we listen to what is happening, ask about substances involved, prior treatment, and any medical or mental-health concerns, then explain the options in plain language. There is no pressure and no judgment. For many people, understanding that detox, residential care, day programs and outpatient support exist on a continuum, and that they can move between them as needs change, makes the idea of treatment feel far more manageable.

Support for Families

Addiction affects the whole family, not just the person using. We can talk through how loved ones can support recovery in healthy ways, what to expect during detox and early treatment, and how aftercare and sober living help protect progress once the structured phase ends.

Insurance & Cost

California Treatment Centers is in-network with most major insurers. We offer free, confidential benefit verification so you can understand your likely coverage before committing to anything. Verify your insurance in minutes, with no obligation.

How to Get Started

Reaching out is a confidential first step, not a commitment. Call 213-321-6518 to speak with our admissions team, ask questions, and learn what care might look like for you or your loved one. You can also explore our California locations to see how we serve communities across the state. If you or someone you love is in crisis, call or text 988 for the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at any time.
